correctness.rationale: For ordinary 3-cut K=Delta_3(C_n²), n>=9, dual L contains all vertices/edges, exactly four cyclic families of connected triangles (4n), and precisely n consecutive-block tetrahedra; no 5-faces. Under s_a, invariant-triangle and invariant-4-face counts are (2,1) for odd n; (4,0) even n/a even; (0,2) even n/a odd. With f fixed vertices, t swaps, Lefschetz Lambda=f-[C(f,2)-t]-T-Q, the top rational H_{n-4} trace is (-1)^t(1-Lambda) by orientation-twisted Alexander duality. Thus all three claimed cases follow. Independently enumerated dual faces and signed reflection Lefschetz for every 9<=n<=18: 4n triangles, n tetrahedra, formula matches every reflection class; no five-face appears. Published shellability concentration is a separate input, not inferred from finite checking.
